critique: The note proves an exact BACKSHIFT-specific population replacement threshold, including a same-class minimax converse through positive-definite witnesses, but it does not prove pointwise necessity for fixed singular invariant noise. Its inference layer establishes coverage only by propagating externally supplied simultaneous covariance regions through a set-valued compatibility map, while contraction additionally assumes a universal condition-number bound over all feasible candidates. The contraction radius is existential and non-effective, so no certified release rule, exact representation, or implementable inference procedure is delivered. The framing accurately leaves those capabilities open, making the delivered contribution a narrow exact identification and design theorem rather than a general robust-inference framework.
